description: This file implements performance monitoring and profiling functions for an AUTOSAR-based system, including task and ISR timing, load calculation, and a shell command for displaying CPU load statistics.

methods.name: shellCmdTop
methods.description: Shell command to display current CPU load and task/ISR statistics.

methods.name: Perf_Init
methods.description: Initializes performance monitoring, registers shell command, and gathers task/ISR info.

methods.name: Perf_Trigger
methods.description: Calculates and updates load percentages for tasks, ISRs, and kernel based on timing data.

methods.name: Os_PreIsrHook
methods.description: Hook called before ISR execution to record start time and increment counters.

methods.name: Os_PostIsrHook
methods.description: Hook called after ISR execution to record end time, update max time, and counters.

methods.name: PreTaskHook
methods.description: Hook called before task execution to record start time and update kernel and task timing data.

methods.name: PostTaskHook
methods.description: Hook called after task execution to record end time, update max time, counters, and kernel start time.
